terra.problem: “He isn't putting it off” asserts a timing the LORD does not give.
“Close to the calendar” is an unclear comparison and does not make sense as a joke.
Saying Abraham picks the title because it matches his subject gives a reason the text does not state.
Abraham asks whether the city will be destroyed, so the LORD's answer is no, not “a yes to Abraham.”
“Not yet” implies fifteen will come up later, but Abraham never asks about fifteen.
